item.title: Indiana Bill Proposes To Make Judges’ Public Information Confidential
item.description: As law enforcement arrested five people last week in connection with the shooting of a Tippecanoe County trial court judge, the Indiana Senate moved forward with a bill that would increase security for the state’s appellate court judges.

item.title: Carl Diehl – PENDING
item.description: Carl Diehl, 94, Warsaw, died Monday, Jan. 26, 2026. Arrangements are pending at McHatton-Sadler Funeral Chapels, Warsaw.

item.title: Norma J. Crowe
item.description: Norma Jean Crowe, 87, Columbia City, died at 10:15 a.m. Monday, Jan. 26, 2026, at Miller’s at Oak Pointe Assisted Living, Columbia City. She was born Dec. 20, 1938, in Whitesville, Ky. On Sept. 6, 1958, she married George Barr Crowe, who preceded her in death in 2023. … Read More

item.title: WPOA launches Wawasee250, a lake-wide celebration
item.description: The Wawasee Property Owners Association has announced Wawasee250, a summer-long community celebration designed to unite the Lake Wawasee area around pride, gratitude, education and anticipation as the nation approaches America’s 250th birthday on July 4.

item.title: Wawa Opening With Free Coffee. What To Know About Indiana’s Newest Store
item.description: Motorists braving the extreme cold this week will have a new travel center at which to fuel their vehicles and bodies in Indiana.

item.description: Ten years ago, he was a standout Warsaw Tiger, his form cutting through the cross-country trails at the state finals or speeding around the track running the 400 or 800.

item.title: CARE Books And More Celebrates Expanded Space With Grand Re-Opening
item.description: CARE Books and More has announced the expansion of its independent bookstore and a new partnership with Baked by Vi, by celebrating with a grand re-opening from 9 a.m. to 2 p.m. Saturday, Feb. 7.

item.title: Echoes of the Past Announces Sponsorship For SummerFest
item.description: Echoes of the Past has announced a partnership with POET Bioprocessing-North Manchester, which will serve as a $1,000 sponsor for the 2026 SummerFest, in downtown North Manchester.

item.title: Essays Due Feb. 3 For National Civics Bee
item.description: Local students with a passion for improving their communities are invited to apply for the 2026 National Civics Bee, with essays due Tuesday, Feb. 3.
